description: Send the files that describe what a project runs (lockfiles, Dockerfiles, .github/workflows/*.yml, wrangler.toml, vercel.json, next.config.*, compose files) in one call. Returns one receipt: every affected package with the exact command to fix it in the tool the repo already uses, actions and images to check, and live incidents for the detected stack that the files cannot rule out.

files.description: Up to 40 files. Paths matter: they pick the reader and the fix command.

name: check_repo
title: Check a whole repo
